title: Great experience
text: I went with my partner and we chose a Balines massage, the experience was very good, the massage very nice, very attentive staff, nice and above all Pro. It's a very charming place, we'll repeat.

title: Great experience!
text: The location was very easy to find it was between the MK store and another high end store. The area inside was very clean and all the specialist were friendly and polite. I would definitely recommend this for a couple!
author: Alma_F

title: Best Thai Spa in Barcelona.
text: It is the fifth time we have gone alone or together to Thai Spa Massage and this time it was a gift for our couple's anniversary. The friendliness of the staff is exquisite as well as the professionalism. Other times we have had a simple foot massage and it has been really like when we had them in Thailand. For us the best Spa in Barcelona.
author: anacE7407BB

title: We'll be back soon.
text: The experience was very good, we chose a massage as a couple, we felt completely relaxed the attention of the masseuse is 10 , we will be back very soon.

title: Excellent massage with intensity and technique
text: I went with my partner on my sister's recommendation, it is well located, the massage room are excellent well equipped the very attentive staff and best of all they are Thai, what we liked about the massage was the applied technique and good intensity, we left happy for the good Service.
